verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity has a full API for creating and tracking verification sessions, retrieving results with a secret key, and receiving webhooks. Its surface is also machine-readable through the platform OpenAPI spec and an official MCP server. But the docs say only "most" verification details are programmatically accessible, and the review tools (status override, blocklist) appear as manual review features with no documented API equivalents, so full UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence that dashboard review actions (override status, add to blocklist) and flow configuration are available via API; explicit documentation of complete API/UI parity; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can access most verification details programmatically... using your secret key.
This API tracks a verification, from initial creation through the entire verification process, and shows verification results upon completion.
the Identity API is machine-readable through the platform spec
